Deploy

Soundboard ships as native apps; nothing runs on a server in 0.1.0. deploy/ holds the containers used to build and check the engine and to serve the docs site the same way on any machine.

Containers

ServiceWhat it doesCommand
engineBuilds the engine on Debian, runs the tests and the routing prototype, then exitsdocker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml run --rm engine
siteServes public/ at http://localhost:8052/make up · make down

Both build from deploy/Dockerfile (targets engine and site).

Apple release (not yet set up)

  1. Set the bundle identifiers and team listed in dev logins.
  2. Bump the version everywhere tools/station/check.mjs compares (see QA).
  3. Product › Archive in Xcode for the Soundboard scheme; upload with the Organizer.

Android release (not yet set up)

  1. Create a release keystore outside the repository; never use the debug keystore.
  2. Add a release signing config that reads the keystore path and passwords from Gradle properties in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties, not from the repository.
  3. gradle :app:bundleRelease.

Docs site

public/ is a static folder with relative links, so it opens from disk. It is internal documentation (tier: internal in station.json) and is not published to station.center.

Source: docs/guides/deploy.md
